in_sanskrit.name: विवस्वन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Vivasvan is derived from the Sanskrit words 'vi' (all), 'vas' (to shine) and 'van' (lord). It means 'All that shines', 'Lord of Shining', or 'Dawn'. It is also known as the name of the Sun God in Hindu mythology.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Vivasvan" is a revered one in Hindu culture, associated with the sun god, Surya. The name "Vivasvan" is mentioned in various Hindu texts including the Rigveda and the Mahabharata. He is also depicted as one of the ancient solar deities in Hindu mythology and considered as the progenitor of the lunar dynasty. In Hindu rituals, the sun god is often invoked for prosperity, well-being, and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Vivasvan" holds deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It is believed that the sun is a symbol of knowledge, enlightenment, and vitality. The sun god represents the spiritual godhead that illuminates one's path towards self-realization and liberation from the cycle of birth and death. The name "Vivasvan" is reminiscent of the divine presence of the sun god in one's life, bestowing upon them the blessings of knowledge, wisdom, vitality, and enlightenment.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Anita Vivasvan in Mumbai, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Vivasvan, which means "The shining one". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Vivasvan is the name of the first Aditya or Sun God in Hindu mythology. It signifies the radiance and illumination of both knowledge and the universe. As a solar deity, Vivasvan embodies the power of life-giving energy and the sustainer of all existence.
